assembly_notes: One rigid desk frame carries a broad rectangular work surface, a support structure (open-knee side panel, four-leg apron, or trestle ends), and one open-front card-catalog bank. The bank derives a regular rows by columns opening grid from the selected multiplicities. Every cell owns a fixed rail pair and one independently moving hollow drawer (open tray or boxed lip-front) with matching moving runners, label holder and one of four pull treatments. Drawer width, height, depth, rail placement and travel derive from the host cavity, so all grid and slot combinations build without compatibility gates or overlap allowances.

derived.rationale: Every column divides the real open-front bank width.

derived.name: opening_height_m
derived.rationale: Every row divides the real open-front bank height.

derived.rationale: The hollow tray remains inside the rear panel at rest.

derived.rationale: Every drawer stays engaged with its rail pair at full travel.

derived.rationale: The grid emits one independent drawer and slide per cell.

multiplicities.name: drawer_columns

multiplicities.name: drawer_rows
